title: Project Alpha
description: A full-stack web application built with React and Node.js that provides real-time collaboration features for remote teams. Includes WebSocket integration, user authentication, and file sharing capabilities.

title: DevTools CLI
description: An open-source command-line toolkit that automates common development workflows including code generation, testing, and deployment. Used by over 500 developers in production environments.

title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A scalable e-commerce platform with microservices architecture, handling thousands of transactions daily. Features include inventory management, payment processing, and order tracking.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: A responsive weather dashboard that displays real-time weather data with interactive charts and maps. Integrates with multiple weather APIs for accurate forecasting.

title: Task Management App
description: A Kanban-style task management application with drag-and-drop functionality, team collaboration features, and progress tracking analytics.

title: Portfolio Generator
description: A static site generator specifically designed for developer portfolios. Supports multiple themes, markdown content, and automatic deployment to various hosting platforms.
